title: The village loses Cedar
summary: A well was built at (15, 4) on day 2, evening. A well was built at (2, 8) on day 6, evening. A granary was built at (3, 8) on day 16, evening.
story: From day 1, night to day 17, afternoon, 11 people lived in the village: Bolt (gatherer), Echo (builder), Gale (explorer), Iris (gatherer), Jade (scholar), Moss (scholar), Nova (explorer), Onyx (scholar), Pike (explorer), Quinn (builder), Thorn (gatherer).
A well was built at (15, 4) on day 2, evening. A well was built at (2, 8) on day 6, evening. A granary was built at (3, 8) on day 16, evening.
Cedar starved to death on day 7, evening.
53 trades were completed, 13 lessons taught, and 60 goods sold at market.

conversations.said: Hello Thorn! Beautiful evening, isn't it? I was just passing by, admiring the area. Have you found much good food around here lately?
conversations.reply: It is, Nova! I've been gathering some food near the plains, around (25, 30) mostly. Have you been exploring further out?

conversations.said: (Thorn smiles warmly) "Hello Nova! It's good to see you. I was just passing by, wondering if you've found any interesting routes today. I'm Thorn, by the way.
conversations.reply: Hello Thorn! It's great to see you too. I've been exploring the area around the stone deposit at (34, 20). Have you found any good foraging spots nearby?

conversations.said: Hello Moss. I'm looking for food. I have some materials I could trade if you know of any good locations.
conversations.reply: Hello Gale. I know of food at (6, 10) and (6, 14). I'd be willing to trade some of my food for your materials.

conversations.said: Hello Nova. I'm looking for more food. Have you discovered any good spots recently? I have some to trade if you need it.
conversations.reply: Hello Thorn! I've found some good food spots near (21, 20) and (22, 25). I'd be happy to trade some of my discoveries for what you have.

conversations.said: Hello Cedar. It's good to see another builder around. I was just thinking about heading towards the materials at (21, 18) if you're interested in working together.
conversations.reply: That's a good offer, Echo. I'm currently low on food and was about to look for some. Perhaps we can find food near those materials, or I can help gather if you need it.

conversations.said: Moss, I'm looking for more food. Do you know of any good spots, or would you be willing to trade some of your materials for my food?
conversations.reply: Gale, I have food, but I'm low on materials. I know of food at (11, 1) and (18, 3) if you're heading that way, but I'd be willing to trade some of my materials for yours.

conversations.said: Hello Thorn. I've noticed a good amount of food near (20, 33). Have you found any other promising spots lately?
conversations.reply: Yes, I've found food at (27, 20) and (29, 28). I'm glad we can share these discoveries.

conversations.said: Hello, Nova. I was just thinking about those food spots you mentioned earlier, like the one near (21, 20). It's good to see you again.
conversations.reply: It's good to see you too, Thorn! I'm glad those food spots were helpful. I was actually heading towards the materials at (21, 18) myself. Have you found any other good gathering spots lately?
